references.text: This verse contains the original instruction to make two tenons for each board of the tabernacle, as Exodus 36:22 describes their execution.
Describes the silver sockets into which the boards' tenons were inserted, complementing the understanding of the boards' construction.
Continuation of the description of how the sockets were made for the boards' tenons, as mentioned in verse 22.
Describes how Moses set up the tabernacle and placed the boards, which were constructed with the tenons described in 36:22.
A thematic parallel showing how both the boards and the curtains were constructed to make the tabernacle one cohesive whole.
